title: Folate supplementation and twin pregnancies
authors: Vollset SE, Gjessing HK, Tandberg A, Rønning T, Irgens LM, Baste V, et al.
followUp: Births from December 1998 to end of 2001
population: Women giving birth in Norway, with folate and multivitamin use and in vitro fertilisation recorded on the Medical Birth Registry notification form
funder: not stated in the abstract; full text not accessible
result: Results read from the published abstract. Preconceptional folate use was associated with twin pregnancy (OR adjusted for age and parity 1.59, 95% CI 1.41 to 1.78), largely through confounding by in vitro fertilisation, which was strongly associated with both. After excluding known IVF pregnancies and accounting for under-reporting of IVF and folate use, OR 1.02 (0.85 to 1.24).
